name: Self-contained flake ice maker (H800 incl. legs)
region: Manufacturer Middle East exact item; supplier availability and local approval not asserted.
note: Selected installed height 800 mm with supplied feet set to 89 mm; body is 711 mm and feet adjust 87-122 mm. Indoor level floor, away from heat and water jets. Manual diagram requires 150 mm left, right, rear and above; front louver and bin-door/service access unobstructed. Potable cold water 5-35 C at 0.05-0.8 MPa, G3/4 inlet; R3/4 gravity waste with downward fall and at least 50 mm vertical air gap to floor drain. Grounded separate 220-240 VAC supply: manual specifies 13 A supply capacity; exact product separately lists 6 A circuit-breaker protection. These distinct ratings are retained, not used to calculate input. R290 is sealed refrigerant, no fuel-gas supply.
